from pathlib import Path
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal
from collections import defaultdict
import re

date_pattern = re.compile(
    r\"2026-\\d{2}-\\d{2}|\\d{1,2}[/-]\\d{1,2}(?:/26)?|\"
    r\"(?:June|Jun\\.?|July|Jul\\.?|August|Aug\\.?)\\s+\\d{1,2}\"
)
groups = {
    \"Eating out / coffee\": [\"Local Coffee Co\", \"Chipotle\", \"McDonald's\", \"Rustic Tap Brewery\", \"Panera Bread\", \"Starbucks\", \"Sushi Kame\", \"Thai Orchid\", \"Bagel Corner\", \"Luigi's Pizza\"],
    \"Shopping\": [\"Steam\", \"Amazon\", \"Best Buy\", \"Home Depot\", \"Target\", \"REI\", \"Barnes & Noble\", \"Old Navy\", \"IKEA\"],
    \"Groceries\": [\"Trader Joe's\", \"Aldi\", \"Kroger\", \"Costco\", \"Whole Foods\"],
    \"Gas\": [\"Shell\", \"Chevron\", \"BP Gas\"],
    \"Subscriptions\": [\"iCloud+ 200GB\", \"Amazon Prime\", \"Netflix\", \"Planet Fitness App\", \"Spotify Premium\"],
    \"Internet / phone\": [\"Xfinity Internet\", \"Verizon Wireless\"],
    \"Fitness\": [\"Planet Fitness\"],
    \"Entertainment\": [\"Spotify Concert\", \"AMC Theatres\", \"Bowl-O-Rama\", \"Ticketmaster\"],
    \"Health / pharmacy\": [\"Riverside Physical Therapy\", \"Walgreens\", \"CVS Pharmacy\", \"Dr. Hensley Dental Copay\"],
    \"Local transport / auto\": [\"Lyft\", \"Uber\", \"City Parking Authority\", \"Jiffy Lube\"],
    \"Travel\": [\"Delta Air Lines\", \"Airport Parking\", \"Marriott\", \"Hertz Rental Car\"],
    \"Uncategorized\": [\"Zelle Payment\", \"ATM Cash Withdrawal\", \"Venmo - Sam\", \"PayPal Transfer\"],
}
categories = {merchant: category for category, merchants in groups.items() for merchant in merchants}
rows, non_transactions, failures, duplicates = [], [], [], []
seen = {}
for line_number, raw in enumerate(Path(\"personal_expenses.txt\").read_text().splitlines(), 1):
    if not raw.strip():
        continue
    match = date_pattern.search(raw)
    if not match:
        (non_transactions if line_number <= 2 else failures).append((line_number, raw))
        continue
    token = match.group()
    if token.startswith(\"2026-\"):
        transaction_date = date.fromisoformat(token)
    elif token[0].isdigit():
        parts = re.split(r\"[/-]\", token)
        transaction_date = date(2026, int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]))
    else:
        month = {\"Jun\": 6, \"Jul\": 7, \"Aug\": 8}[token[:3]]
        transaction_date = date(2026, month, int(token.split()[-1]))
    remainder = raw[:match.start()] + raw[match.end():]
    amounts = list(re.finditer(r\"-?\\"'$'"\\d+\\.\\d{2}|\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", remainder))
    if len(amounts) "'!= 1:
        failures.append((line_number, raw))
        continue
    amount_match = amounts[0]
    cents = int(Decimal(amount_match.group().replace("$", "")) * 100)
    merchant = (remainder[:amount_match.start()] + remainder[amount_match.end():]).strip(" -:|,()")
    merchant = re.sub(r"''^Return processed'"\\s*-\\s*\", \"\", merchant)
    category = categories.get(merchant, \"Uncategorized\")
    key = (transaction_date, merchant, cents)
    if key in seen:
        duplicates.append((line_number, seen[key], key))
        continue
    seen[key] = line_number
    rows.append((line_number, transaction_date, merchant, cents, category))

totals = defaultdict(int)
for _, day, merchant, cents, category in rows:
    totals[(day.month, category)] += cents
money = lambda cents: f\"{cents / 100:,.2f}\"
months = (6, 7, 8)
print(\"MONTHLY: category | June | July | August | Quarter\")
for category in groups:
    values = [totals[(month, category)] for month in months]
    print(category, *map(money, values), money(sum(values)), sep=\" | \")
monthly = {month: sum(totals[(month, category)] for category in groups) for month in months}
print(\"TOTAL\", *[money(monthly[m]) for m in months], money(sum(monthly.values())), sep=\" | \")
print(\"BUDGET: month | category | net | target | net minus target\")
for month in months:
    for category, target in [(\"Eating out / coffee\", 26000), (\"Shopping\", 120000)]:
        value = totals[(month, category)]
        print(month, category, money(value), money(target), money(value-target), sep=\" | \")
print(\"CHANGES: category | June to July | July to August\")
for category in groups:
    print(category, money(totals[(7,category)]-totals[(6,category)]), money(totals[(8,category)]-totals[(7,category)]), sep=\" | \")
print(\"TOTAL CHANGE\", money(monthly[7]-monthly[6]), money(monthly[8]-monthly[7]))
print(\"NON TRANSACTIONS\", non_transactions)
print(\"FAILURES\", failures)
print(\"DUPLICATES\", duplicates)
print(\"UNCATEGORIZED AND REFUNDS\")
for row in rows:
    if row[4] == \"Uncategorized\" or row[3] < 0:
        print(row)
print(\"COUNTS\", \"retained\", len(rows), \"duplicates\", len(duplicates), \"failures\", len(failures))
print(\"SAME DATE/MERCHANT WITH DIFFERENT AMOUNTS\")
pairs = defaultdict(list)
for row in rows:
    pairs[(row[1], row[2])].append((row[0], row[3]))
for key, entries in pairs.items():
    if len(entries) > 1:
        print(key, entries)

'@ | python -"
